title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Missing floor guard allows division by zero
description: Line 127 explains implementations use N = NChannels - 1 but omits the floor guard. If NChannels is 0 or 1, this causes division by zero. The Python example at line 306 shows the correct formula max(n_channels - 1, 1), but this guard is not reflected in the normative note. Implementations following the note exactly will crash with NChannels <= 1.
close_reason: Fixed: Added floor guard max(NChannels - 1, 1) to normative note at line 127, making it consistent with implementation example at line 306
